# @canopy/native

The Canopy core in Rust for Bun, Node and Deno: the policy engine, the event matcher, query canonicalization and the EJSON codec, as a prebuilt Node-API addon with a WebAssembly fallback.

Set `server.engine` (or `CANOPY_ENGINE`) to `native` to run the policy engine and the event matcher in Rust. A prebuilt addon is installed for each platform, and WebAssembly is the fallback everywhere else, so no Rust toolchain is needed.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/native
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { selectEngine } from "@canopy/native"

const core = selectEngine("native")
const open = core.compileFilter({ status: "open", total: { $gte: 100 } })
open.matches({ status: "open", total: 120 }) // true, decided in Rust
```
